rubric.role_summary: Creative director for performance video advertising, leading paid-social creative strategy, concepts, scripts, testing, and a creative team, with AI-assisted production and client-facing work.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Creative director for performance video advertising, leading paid-social creative strategy, concepts, scripts, testing, and a creative team, with AI-assisted production and client-facing work.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years in creative direction, paid social advertising, or agency-side performance creative.
- Experience managing creative teams.
- Proficiency with Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, or equivalent.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Former creative agency owner or co-founder.
- Fluency in social-first ad formats and user behavior on major platforms.
- Experience using metrics to guide creative decisions.
- Experience managing creative teams in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
- Hands-on experience with AI creative tools, such as Veo3, Sora2, Kling, or similar, and skill turning them into repeatable production workflows.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
